description: Automatically picks the Codex model and reasoning effort for each request, without spending tokens to decide. Unofficial extension, not affiliated with OpenAI.
cfg.language: Language of the SmartShift panel and of the planning instructions sent to Codex.
cfg.codexPath: Path to the `codex` executable. Empty = looks for the binary of the official Codex extension, then `codex` on PATH. Accepts `${workspaceFolder}`.
cfg.tiers: Model and reasoning effort for each tier. If the model is not available on your account, the Codex default model is used.
cfg.thresholds: Minimum score for each tier. Below `medium` the request is `simple`.
cfg.planExecute: Plan → execute. `when`: `complex` (complex requests) or `never`. The `planner` writes the plan in read-only mode; the `executor` tier carries it out. `autoExecute`: execute without asking.
cfg.signals: Signals that raise the conversation tier after a request (no tokens spent). `failedCommands`: failed commands in a row at the end of the request (errors Codex fixed later don't count). `filesChanged`: files changed in one request (not counted when executing a plan). `0` disables. A failed request always raises the tier.
cfg.developerInstructions: Extra instructions sent to Codex in every new conversation (added to Codex's own). `null` = automatic: on Windows, asks Codex to wait longer for commands instead of polling every second (each poll resends the history). `""` disables.
cfg.extraComplexKeywords: Extra words that indicate a complex task (+3 each).
cfg.extraSimpleKeywords: Extra words that indicate a simple task (-2 each).
cfg.sandbox: What Codex is allowed to do on disk.
cfg.approvalPolicy: When Codex should ask for your approval.
